findings.title: Render-blocking CSS chain in <head>
findings.description: 5 stylesheets (tokens.css, [page].css, fonts.css, utilities.css, rewards.css) load serially before first paint, no critical CSS inlined.
findings.recommendation: Inline above-the-fold critical CSS, defer/bundle the rest.
